A finished emotionally devastating black-and-white dark fantasy action manga page, four cinematic panels read top to bottom. A beautiful adult heroine duels her former lover in heavy rain in a ruined gothic courtyard at night. Consistent heroine across all panels: adult woman aged 25, extremely beautiful delicate face, long flowing white hair, dark fitted armored dress with lace details and flowing black cape, silver sword, small crescent pendant. Opponent: adult man aged 28, short black hair, dark knight armor and torn cape. Their expressions show grief and hesitation rather than hatred. Elegant fierce choreography, huge sweeping hair and cape arcs, sharp sword silhouettes, sparks, motion lines, dramatic foreshortening, high contrast ink, intricate crosshatching, solid blacks and clean white negative space, white panel gutters. The central action panel must occupy most of the page and clearly show BOTH combatants and their crossed swords. No gore, no nudity. Only render the specified Chinese caption, no extra writing.
